auth_failed.title: Authentication Failed
auth_failed.description:
Your Thermacell credentials are invalid or have expired. Please reauthenticate to continue using this integration.

Go to **Settings** → **Devices & Services**, find the **Thermacell LIV** integration, click the three dots menu and select **Reauthenticate**.

device_offline.title: Device Offline
device_offline.description:
Your Thermacell device **{device_name}** is currently offline or unreachable.

**Troubleshooting steps:**
- Check that the device has power
- Verify your home network connectivity
- Check if the Thermacell cloud service is operational
- Try power cycling the device

This issue will automatically resolve when the device comes back online.

shutdown_unconfirmed.title: Timed shutdown could not be confirmed
shutdown_unconfirmed.description: The shutdown deadline for **{device_name}** passed, but operational Off could not be confirmed. Automatic recovery has not confirmed shutdown. New starts are blocked until a fresh report confirms Off. Check the hub and its reported System State and System Status; Enable Repellers=false alone does not confirm shutdown. The native timer is retained. Recover the hub manually if needed, then refresh. No automatic reboot is performed.
